title: Captain Silvo
description: Silvo, one of the many aliases of the man who introduced himself to Wim, Fern, and the rest as Jod Na Nawood, was the mysterious masked captain of a pirate ship. The pirate Brutus turned on him and led the rest of the crew in a mutiny after a score they were going after turned out to be nothing but a single credit, throwing Silvo into the brig.
